entities.name: Max Verstappen
entities.description: Max Emilian Verstappen was born on 30 September 1997 in Hasselt, Belgium, to Jos Verstappen and Sophie Kumpen.

entities.name: Red Bull Racing
entities.description: Verstappen is contracted to remain at Red Bull until at least the end of the 2030 season.
As of the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix, Verstappen has achieved 72 race wins.
